as_told.title: Host's own expedition to the anomaly
as_told.place_text: Baltic Sea, 60 km out between Finland and Sweden

plain: On the floor of the Baltic Sea, roughly midway between Sweden and Finland, a team of treasure-hunting divers says it found a strange object shaped like the Millennium Falcon, the round spaceship from Star Wars. Dennis Asberg, the Swedish treasure hunter who made the find, tells it first-hand. He says the object showed up on side scan sonar, a device that maps the seabed with sound, on 19 June 2011, and that his partner Peter Lindberg laughed and said "here is UFO". Michels says he went to the site himself in 2025, about 60 kilometres out to sea. The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel tells it as something she heard about: a team of divers found "something that looked like a crashed UFO or looked like an artificial structure". She places it off the Swedish coast rather than between the two countries. If it is what some suggest, a crashed craft is lying on the seabed.
